dysflow._dysflow_marker: OpenCode-specific MCP server config for the dysflow-plugin. Server namespace 'dysflow' is the canonical identifier. DO NOT rename without coordinating with the plugin installer. Coexists with engram's MCP server (which declares mcpServers.engram).

_dysflow_marker_root: DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY — replaced on plugin update. Coexists with engram's OpenCode plugin (Gentleman-Programming/engram). Two MCP servers — dysflow (per-worktree Access/VBA) + engram (per-user memory) — load side-by-side.
_dysflow_opencode_plugin: The plugin itself lives at plugin/opencode/dysflow.ts in this repo. After `setup.sh` runs, OpenCode loads it from ~/.config/opencode/plugins/dysflow/dysflow.ts (or wherever OpenCode's plugin loader expects).
